title: Trust and Obey
lyrics_original: When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will, He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.
Trust and obey- For there’s no other way
To be happy in Jesus, But to trust and obey.
When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will, He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.       || Trust ||
Not a shadow can rise, Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt not a fear, Not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.       || Trust ||
Then in fellowship sweet, We will sit at His feet,
Or we’ll walk by His side in the way;
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go-
Never fear, only trust and obey.       || Trust ||

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే ఆయన వెలుగులోనున్న ప్రకారము మనమును వెలుగులో నడిచినయెడల. మనము అన్యోన్యసహవాసము గలవారమై యుందుము; అప్పుడు ఆయన కుమారుడైన యేసు రక్తము ప్రతి ఎ
bible_verses.english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

bible_verses.telugu: నేను నా తండ్రి ఆజ్ఞలు గైకొని ఆయన ప్రేమయందు నిలిచియున్న ప్రకారము  మీరును నా ఆజ్ఞలు గైకొనినయెడల నా ప్రేమయందు నిలిచియుందురు.
bible_verses.english: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ స్వబుద్ధిని ఆధారము చేసికొనక నీ పూర్ణహృదయముతో యెహోవాయందు నమ్మక ముంచుము నీ ప్రవర్తన అంతటియందు ఆయన అధికారమునకు  ఒప్పుకొనుము అప్పుడు ఆయన నీ త్రోవలను సరాళము చేయును.
bible_verses.english: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the grace that lights my path every single day. Forgive me for the times I try to lean on my own understanding instead of resting in Your goodness. Teach me to surrender my worries and gladly follow Your Word. May my heart find its deepest joy in walking closely with You, trusting Your promise to abide with me always. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the grace that lights my path every single day. Forgive me for the times I try to lean on my own understanding instead of resting in Your goodness. Teach me to surrender my worries and gladly follow Your Word. May my heart find its deepest joy in walking closely with You, trusting Your promise to abide with me always. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Walking with Jesus isn't about having every step mapped out; it is about trusting the One who lights our path. When we align our hearts with God's Word, we discover a sweet joy that no circumstance can steal. True happiness in Christ comes not from relying on our own strength, but from resting in His faithful love and following His gentle guidance. Today, let His presence illuminate your journey as you simply choose to trust and obey.
